executiveSummary: Multiple active, OT-directed campaigns continue to target PLCs and industrial facilities. U.S. water utilities are reporting real service impacts from actors changing PLC credentials and network settings, forcing manual operations and boil-water advisories. Security Advisory Iranian-affiliated actors are actively manipulating PLC logic and HMI data across U.S. critical infrastructure, including Energy and Water/Wastewater, using vendor tools on standard ICS protocols (CIP/EtherNet-IP, Modbus/TCP, S7). Security Advisory Europe: CERT Polska reports a destructive December 2025 OT intrusion at a CHP plant via a misconfigured private APN, leading to turbine and water treatment shutdown-an access pattern likely replicated elsewhere. Supporting Report Ransomware ecosystem risk is elevated: a joint U.S.-ROK advisory on Gunra RaaS details Fortinet-edge exploitation, Microsoft 365 exfiltration, and cross-platform lockers; defenders should leverage provided IOCs and a Linux key-recovery weakness. Security Advisory Enterprise-edge and identity surfaces that commonly bridge to OT are under active exploitation: KEV additions include Cisco ASA/FTD, Windows AFD LPE, Metabase, Progress LoadMaster, N-able N-central, and TeamCity; urgent remediation and compromise assessment are required. CISA Alert CISA Alert High-impact product issues with direct OT or facility-security consequences were disclosed, including an unauthenticated deserialization RCE in Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000/victor Application Server and persistent remote access on VMware vCenter via a critical RCE. Security Advisory View Article Nation-state pre-positioning via covert SOHO/IoT proxy networks remains a strategic concern for enterprise-to-OT pivots. Security Advisory

items: Iranian-affiliated APT actively tampering with PLC logic/HMI data across U.S. sectors (ports 44818/2222, 102, 502, 22). Security Advisory
China-nexus operators leveraging covert SOHO/IoT botnets for proxying and pre-positioning against CI. Security Advisory
Void Blizzard (Russia) mass-exfiltrating Zimbra email via webmail XSS; theft of 2FA and IMAP persistence noted. Security Advisory
Lazarus using a Windows AFD zero-day (CVE-2026-68820) for LPE; organizations must patch and harden Windows endpoints in OT-adjacent zones. View Article
Gunra RaaS: Fortinet-edge exploitation, Microsoft 365 data theft, and ChaCha20+RSA lockers; Linux variant key recovery path detailed. Security Advisory
SharePoint deserialization RCE under active ransomware exploitation; many internet-exposed servers remain unpatched. View Article
Covert SOHO/IoT proxy and residential proxy networks expand attacker infrastructure, complicating attribution and geofencing. View Article
Johnson Controls C-CURE 9000 / victor Application Server - unauthenticated .NET deserialization to RCE (restrict port 8999; upgrade). Security Advisory
VMware vCenter Server - CVE-2026-59310 RCE exploited in the wild; observed persistence via cron and reverse SSH. View Article
Progress LoadMaster - KEV-listed command injection; full device compromise risk at the edge. CISA Alert
Cisco Secure Firewall ASA/FTD - actively exploited VPN-path DoS via crafted HTTP to RA SSL-VPN endpoints. View Article
TeamCity - KEV-listed deserialization (supply-chain CI compromise risk). CISA Alert
SAP MII, SAP Commerce Cloud - critical code execution and injection issues crossing IT-OT boundaries in manufacturing. View Article

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): vCenter RCE, SharePoint RCE, TeamCity deserialization, LoadMaster command injection. View Article CISA Alert
Valid Accounts (T1078) and Remote Services (T1021): Fortinet VPN abuse, RDP/SMB lateral movement (Gunra). Security Advisory
Proxy/Exfil via Multi-Hop (T1090/T1041): China-nexus covert SOHO/IoT networks; Google Apps Script relay (CAV3RN). Security Advisory View Article
Privilege Escalation (T1068): Windows AFD/afd.sys LPE under active exploitation. View Article
Modify Controller Tasking / Manipulation of Control (ICS tactics): Iranian-affiliated PLC logic tampering; WWS PLC password/IP changes. Security Advisory Security Advisory

outlook72h: Expect continued probing and exploitation of publicly exposed SharePoint, vCenter, and VPN/firewall endpoints; prioritize emergency patch windows and temporary exposure reductions. Increase monitoring for PLC credential changes, unexpected mode transitions, and HMI alarm suppression-particularly at smaller utilities and sites with legacy remote access. Conduct targeted compromise assessments on KEV-affected devices/services; rotate credentials, tokens, and certificates associated with edge and CI/CD platforms. Validate backup integrity and recovery for PACS (C-CURE/victor), PLC logic, and Windows domain services supporting OT operations.
